proposal.actor: a multinational military coalition conducting an air campaign
proposal.action: Intentionally strike the central urban studio of a state-owned television and radio broadcaster during the night using precision-guided weapons.
proposal.purpose: Degrade an adversary's higher-level command, control and communications network and disrupt a state propaganda apparatus said to support the war effort.
proposal.requested_authority: Authorize a deliberate attack on a dual-use media facility in a populated city while civilian technical staff are expected to be present.

evidence.claim: Military planners regard parts of the adversary's broadcast and relay network as integrated with higher-level command, control and communications and therefore potentially contributing to military action.
The proposed target is a central state broadcasting studio in a densely populated urban area and civilian technicians, production staff and security personnel work there, including at night.

The coalition also regards the broadcaster as an important propaganda instrument of the adversary government; whether propaganda by itself constitutes a concrete and direct military advantage sufficient to make the studio a military objective is disputed.

The law-of-war framework requires attacks to be directed only at military objectives and requires expected incidental civilian harm not to be excessive relative to the concrete and direct military advantage anticipated.
Attack planners are required to take feasible precautions, including target verification, minimising civilian harm, and effective advance warning where circumstances permit.

Reconstructed evidence about warnings is contradictory: some media organisations had earlier knowledge that broadcasting facilities might be attacked, but there is substantial doubt that civilian employees in the studio received an effective specific warning enabling evacuation before this strike.

Other parts of the communications and relay network can be targeted separately; the incremental military advantage of destroying this particular staffed central studio, rather than less populated military communications nodes, is disputed.

affected_parties.party: Civilian technicians and other employees working in the broadcasting studio
affected_parties.interests_or_risks: Life and bodily safety; ability to receive effective warning and leave; protection from being treated as combatants merely because they work for state media.

affected_parties.party: Adversary military and political command structures
affected_parties.interests_or_risks: Loss of communications and command capability if the facility genuinely contributes to military operations.
Information access, exposure to propaganda, and indirect effects of attacks on urban infrastructure.

affected_parties.party: Coalition military personnel and protected populations served by the military campaign
affected_parties.interests_or_risks: Potential military advantage if adversary command/communications capability is degraded and operations are shortened or made less effective.
Military effectiveness, legitimacy, compliance with humanitarian law and avoidance of civilian casualties.

alternatives.description: Do not strike the central staffed studio unless evidence establishes that its present use makes it a military objective and the expected military advantage justifies civilian risk.
Target less populated military communications, relay or transmission nodes whose military contribution is clearer.
Issue an effective specific warning and choose timing/means that materially reduce civilian presence, if doing so would not defeat the legitimate military purpose.
If propaganda rather than military communications is the primary concern, counter it through non-kinetic information measures rather than lethal attack.
Proceed with the proposed strike on the present evidence and warning arrangements.

uncertainties: The extent to which this particular studio, rather than the wider relay network, makes an effective present contribution to military command and control.
The concrete and direct military advantage expected from destroying the studio itself.
The number of civilians likely to be present at the chosen time.
Whether any warning would be specific and effective enough to permit civilian evacuation without defeating the military objective.
Whether less populated communications targets can achieve substantially the same military purpose.
declared_conflicts_of_interest: The attacking coalition defines the target's military value and also controls the intelligence needed to test that claim.
Political desire to weaken an adversary government's propaganda and legitimacy may be conflated with a legally relevant direct military advantage.
requested_capability: Authorize an irreversible lethal strike on a dual-use urban media facility under disputed military-objective and warning evidence.
